script.base: Houston is laid 10 with a 26.2 implied total and should lead by halftime or early in the second half. NYG (implied 16.2) cannot lean on the run against a HOU front at 3.53 YPC, so the dog falls behind and throws: Nabers (42 targets, 398 yards, 503 air yards in weeks 4-6) and Likely (36 targets, 259 yards) carry the pass game while Skattebo (31 carries, 117 yards) and Tracy (10 carries, 23 yards) get scripted down. Houston, once ahead, bleeds clock with Marks after Montgomery was ruled out, unless NYG's 42% blitz keeps Stroud in a throw script (HOU EPA/db +0.40 when blitzed).
script.flip1: NYG's deep game hits the backup safeties and the game stays inside one score. Houston cannot just run, Collins (20 targets, 248 yards L3) and Noel stay in a pass-volume script, Marks never gets the late carry pile, and both passing games push the 42.5 total up.
script.flip2: Houston is up 17-plus by halftime. NYG abandons the run entirely and may bench the QB late, so Nabers/Likely snap counts are at risk in garbage time, and Marks can lose fourth-quarter carries once the lead is safe. Tracy still does not become the bellcow.

injury_fallout: HOU: David Montgomery Out (groin, nflverse pre-game) so Marks is next man — weeks 4-6 he had 36 carries to Montgomery's 15 and J.Jordan's 6, about 5 vacated carries per game. Both safeties Jalen Pitre (shoulder) and Reed Blankenship (concussion) Out, which opens deep and middle throws for Nabers and Likely. Tank Dell Questionable (knee) with no prior games in the log; if he sits, the existing Collins/Noel/Hutchinson/Boutte rotation absorbs it, no new name in the target log. T Blake Fisher Out (thumb) — pressure and run-fit risk, quick-game lean. NYG: CB Greg Newsome II Out (concussion), S Jevon Holland Out (concussion), CB Paulson Adebo Questionable (knee), S Tyler Nubin Questionable (neck), LB Tremaine Edmunds Out (shoulder) — coverage and second-level losses in front of Collins, Noel, Schultz and Marks. TE Theo Johnson Doubtful (neck) had only 4 targets L3; Likely already owns that role. T Jermaine Eluemunor Questionable (calf) and T Marcus Mbow Questionable (knee) — if both sit, pressure rises, Nabers' 503 air yards are the casualty and checkdowns rise. Sources: nflverse injury report in the pack; target and carry splits weeks 4-6.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and this lost because Eluemunor and Mbow were inactive, Houston's low-blitz rush turned the Giants into three-and-outs, and Nabers posted another 26-yard game while the 16.2 implied total showed up as empty possessions rather than a catch-up air raid — the unpriced 69 was a stale board, not a bet. Tracy busted the under when Skattebo was stuffed early, the committee gave Tracy a couple extra carries, and one 12-yard run on a 3.53 YPC defense still got him to 24. The same blowout that was supposed to kill NYG rushing instead produced a garbage-time draw.
slip_story: One base-script stack: NYG trails, so they throw to the primary (Nabers recyds over) and they do not run (Tracy rushyds under). Those two win together if Houston leads and the Giants are forced off a 3.53 YPC run defense. Do not add Collins or Noel overs — those need Houston to keep throwing. Do not add Skattebo rush over — same negative run script. Marks rush over is the favorite clock-kill correlate but it was dropped as a lean the game log does not confirm.
